hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ -f package.json ] || exit 0; grep -qE '"stop_hook_active": ?true' && exit 0; OUT=$(npm run lint 2>&1 && npm run build 2>&1 && npm run test 2>&1) || { echo "$OUT" >&2; exit 2; }
if grep -qiE 'rm\s+-[a-z]*(r[a-z]*f|f[a-z]*r)|git\s+push(\s.*)?\s(-f|--force)|git\s+reset\s+--hard|git\s+clean\s+-[a-z]*f|drop\s+table'; then echo 'BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어가 감지되었습니다.' >&2; exit 2; fi
